data.summary: At 9 in flight and limit 3, `ddflow next --phase bugs-2` blocks fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main with 'parallelism cap reached (fixed: limit 3, limited by reviewer latency ratio)', while `ddflow wait --item fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main --timeout 0` exits 0 with 'READY ... claim now'. The code comment in ddflow/api/lifecycle/wait.py and test_a_cap_blocked_item_wait_agrees_with_claim say claim does not apply the cap to a named item, but ddflow/templates/prompts/help/parallel.md says claim refuses 'when the parallelism caps are full' and that fixed means max_parallel_tasks 'is the limit', while the schedule.parallel knob says signals may lower it. So an agent cannot tell from ddflow whether the cap is a real stop, and next's waiting_on names a wait that never happens because wait returns at once.
data.title: Claim, wait, next and help disagree on whether the parallelism cap holds a named item

Fixes bug Ba7c5816744: At 9 in flight and limit 3, `ddflow next --phase bugs-2` blocks fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main with 'parallelism cap reached (fixed: limit 3, limited by reviewer latency ratio)', while `ddflow wait --item fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main --timeout 0` exits 0 with 'READY ... claim now'. The code comment in ddflow/api/lifecycle/wait.py and test_a_cap_blocked_item_wait_agrees_with_claim say claim does not apply the cap to a named item, but ddflow/templates/prompts/help/parallel.md says claim refuses 'when the parallelism caps are full' and that fixed means max_parallel_tasks 'is the limit', while the schedule.parallel knob says signals may lower it. So an agent cannot tell from ddflow whether the cap is a real stop, and next's waiting_on names a wait that never happens because wait returns at once. Found on fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Ba7c5816744 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Ba7c5816744 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Ba7c5816744: Claim, wait, next and help disagree on whether the parallelism cap holds a named item
